name: Trained Sharpshooter's [Class Bonus] Ranged 2 attack bonus
notes: Unlike Automaton Bomber's unconditional Ranged 4, Trained Sharpshooter's Ranged 2 needs an active RANGER Class Bonus (IsClassBonusActive scans the whole field for any champion-type object of the matching class), so a real RANGER champion (Diana, Keen Huntress) is seeded onto player 2's field alongside it. Same turn-cycle approach as automaton-bomber-ranged-attack: Rule 1.h blocks the opening player's own turn-1 attack, so player 1 ends turn 1 with a single CustomInput Pass (no decision is pending, so this action itself ends the turn) before player 2 attacks on turn 2, Distant and awake.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Ranged 2 (As long as this unit is distant, its attacks get +2 POWER. Apply this effect only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)
